title: Top hat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8be9fd' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8be9fd' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='45' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#7b4bd1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#9a6bff'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='30' y='26' width='40' height='53' rx='4' fill='#9a6bff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='26' width='40' height='53' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#c3a6ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='40' height='10' fill='#ff5f9e'/>
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='40' height='3' fill='#ffa3c8'/>
  <!-- face on the crown -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='3.6' ry='5' fill='#ffe37a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='44' rx='3.6' ry='5' fill='#ffe37a'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='1.5' ry='2.2' fill='#2b1a55'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='44' rx='1.5' ry='2.2' fill='#2b1a55'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ff9ec9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ff9ec9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 55 Q50 64 60 55' fill='none' stroke='#ffe37a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
